latin: Ausculta, o fili, praecepta magistri, et inclina aurem cordis tui.
text: Listen, my son, to the master's instructions, and incline the ear of your heart.

source: Motto of the Benedictine tradition (not a literal quotation from the Rule)

text: Prefer nothing to the love of Christ.

latin: Mortem cotidie ante oculos suspectam habere.
text: Keep death daily before your eyes.

latin: Et de Dei misericordia numquam desperare.
text: And never despair of God's mercy.

latin: Omni tempore silentium debent studere monachi.
text: Monks should cultivate silence at all times.
Therefore let nothing be put before the Work of God.
Idleness is the enemy of the soul.

latin: Omnes supervenientes hospites tamquam Christus suscipiantur.
text: Let all guests who arrive be received as Christ.
That in all things God may be glorified.

latin: Christo omnino nihil praeponant, qui nos pariter ad vitam aeternam perducat.
text: Let them prefer nothing whatever to Christ, who may bring us all together to everlasting life.
Run while you have the light of life.

latin: Constituenda est ergo nobis dominici schola servitii.
text: We are therefore about to establish a school for the Lord's service.

latin: Ante omnia et super omnia infirmorum cura adhibenda est.
text: Before all things and above all things, care must be taken of the sick.
